description: recipient_domain in relay_client.rs uses addr.rfind('@').map(|i| &addr[i + 1..]). Since Rust 1.52, str::rsplit_once is the idiomatic way to split on the last occurrence: addr.rsplit_once('@').map(|(_, domain)| domain). Both produce the same result but rsplit_once communicates the intent ('split on the last @, take the right side') directly without the manual index arithmetic.
title: recipient_domain uses rfind('@') + manual slice; rsplit_once('@') is cleaner
